content:
Apple just released iPadOS 27, the next major software update for iPad users. Here's an overview of the new features.

iPadOS 27 is officially here, bringing Siri AI, brand new app features, upgraded parental controls, and more.

iPad users, Apple just dropped iPadOS 27, the next major software update. Users can install the update via Settings → General → Software Update.

For a list of compatible iPad models, check out this article, which lists five models that previously supported iPadOS 26 but are no longer supported this time around. Models no longer supported include the iPad Pro 12.9-inch (3rd generation), iPad Pro 11-inch (1st generation), iPad (8th generation), iPad mini 5, and iPad Air 3.

The headliner of Apple's iPadOS 27 this time is Siri AI, a major upgrade to the voice assistant that's smarter and more personalized than ever. Users can launch Siri AI through a dedicated Siri app, by swiping down from the screen, or via previously supported methods like "Hey Siri" or holding down the side button.

Spotlight search has been integrated with Siri, and it's one of my favorite changes this year.

iPadOS 27 brings several updates that make the iPad feel more like a Mac, such as adding the app name to the status bar and the option to keep the menu bar always visible.

System apps also benefit from a host of new features in iPadOS 27. You can read about the new features in Messages, Notes, Photos, Calendar, Mail, Reminders, Maps, Safari, and Apple Music via the links below.

Apple also brings a set of upgraded Screen Time features and other parental control options with iPadOS 27. This update also includes various system improvements and bug fixes that should make your iPad run more smoothly.

To learn more about iPadOS 27, check out our full coverage.

What's your favorite new feature in iPadOS 27? Let us know in the comments.
